author: Jessica Patterson
title: West Virginia service member's family receives new roof - NewsBreak
text:
By Jessica Patterson ,
3 hours ago RIPLEY, W.Va. (WOWK) - A new roof was something one West Virginia family says they've been working toward for a while, and now, with some help, it's a reality.
Renna Thompson says her husband, Nathaniel Thompson, even took a deployment so they could put more money away to get the roof of their Jackson County home fixed. While he was away, she entered him into the Green's Building Products, LLC, Veteran Roof Giveaway, never thinking they'd actually win.
But they did.
"We needed a new roof, so we've been putting back money and putting back money. The deployment opportunity came, and he's like, 'Look, we can put back even more. We can get this roof when I deploy.' So he took the deployment," Renna said. "And I saw this come up, and I didn't tell him because he would have been like, 'No, don't do that.' And I nominated him and never dreamed in a million years that we would be the ones that one. God just - I guess he knew. He knew we needed this, so it's just a blessing."
The Thompson family of Jackson County, West Virginia, receives a new roof thanks to Green's Building Products' Veteran Roof Giveaway. Aug. 26, 2026. (Photo Credit: WOWK 13 News Photojournalist Michael Magee) The Thompson family of Jackson County, West Virginia, receives a new roof thanks to Green's Building Products' Veteran Roof Giveaway. Aug. 26, 2026. (Photo Credit: WOWK 13 News Photojournalist Michael Magee) Green's brought the contest together with materials provided by IKO Roofing , with A Plus Contractors making it happen.
"It feels great just because we know she needed it, and we had a lot of people that actually put in for the roof," said Brandon Moore, President of Green's. "It was hard to just pick one person, but what really made it great is they really needed it and they're very appreciative of it. And we're really excited to see her reaction once it's done.
